notes: You'll now get a notification when a new update is ready to install. Jadhagam readings now also accept a photo or a Word document, not just a PDF. Acupressure relief now covers neck/shoulders, stomach, and hands/wrists/knees, with gentler guidance for kids and seniors. Fixed the News tab being unreachable on some screens. Also new: a daily "how are you" check-in that quietly lets your family know if it goes unanswered.
